title: Handoff accept should say when the work's live offer is addressed to a different recipient, instead of "ambient work has no live incoming handoff offer"
outcome: A session that tries to accept a handoff whose live offer names someone else (for example a display name rather than its session id) gets a refusal naming that mismatch and the offer's recipient, so the owner can re-offer to the right session without a diagnosis round.
acceptance: When the focused work has exactly one live outgoing offer whose recipient is not the calling session, `handoff accept` refuses with a reason that says the offer is addressed to a different recipient and names that recipient as recorded, rather than the generic "ambient work has no live incoming handoff offer"
The genuine no-offer case keeps its current refusal, and acceptance by the named recipient is unchanged
A test covers the mismatched-recipient refusal and the unchanged no-offer and matching-recipient paths
